SELECT t.tenant_id, u.user_id, u.username, u.status, t.tenant_code, t.display_name, c.password_hash, c.failed_attempt_count, c.locked_until FROM user_account u JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id JOIN user_credential c ON c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credential SET failed_attempt_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_by_type = 'SERVICE', updated_by_id = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credential (tenant_id, user_id, credential_kind, password_hash, password_hash_scheme, failed_attempt_count, locked_until, password_changed_at, lock_version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, 'PASSWORD', #{passwordHash}, #{scheme}, 0, NULL, #{now}, 0, #{now}, 'USER', #{actorId}, #{now}, 'USER', #{actorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credential SET failed_attempt_count = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE failed_attempt_count + 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{now} THEN NULL ELSE locked_until END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_by_type = 'SERVICE', updated_by_id = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
